title: Run the Velora admin panel on Cloudflare staging and fix auth/API at the root
railway: not used anywhere in the path (the rewrite that pointed there was removed)

root_cause.why_not_the_api: the kernel's own 404 is {"status":"error","error":{"code":"NOT_FOUND","requestId":"<uuid>"}} (apps/api/src/kernel/server.ts); the observed envelope is a platform envelope and carries no requestId from the API
root_cause.why_it_happened: apps/web/next.config.ts rewrote /api/:path* at BUILD time to VELORA_API_ORIGIN, which in the deployed bundle was https://velora-modern-staging.up.railway.app (see apps/web-edge-cf/wrangler.jsonc). That host no longer exists, so no API was ever reached
root_cause.fix_direction: give the API a Cloudflare origin (apps/api-cf) and route /api/* to it at REQUEST time from a route handler

architecture.single_dispatch: apps/api/src/kernel/server.ts exports createRequestListener(config); createApp is a 4-line wrapper. Node and Worker call the same function
architecture.api_host: apps/api-cf (nodeHttpBridge + runtime + 3-line fetch entry) on Worker velora-api-staging, Hyperdrive velora-pg-nonprod → Neon staging
architecture.panel_host: apps/web built by @opennextjs/cloudflare 1.20.12 (next 16.4.1) on Worker velora-modern-staging (origin preserved, so no DNS change)
architecture.api_hop: apps/web/src/app/api/[...path]/route.ts forwards same-origin /api/* to VELORA_API_ORIGIN resolved per request via apps/web/src/lib/apiOrigin.ts
architecture.gate: apps/web/src/proxy.ts SEC-04 gate unchanged in behaviour; its probe origin is now read per request instead of at module load

bug_found_by_running_it.symptom: every route 500 in workerd: TypeError: The "path" argument must be of type string or an instance of URL. Received undefined, at fileURLToPath (defaultIconsDir)
bug_found_by_running_it.cause: the icon directory was resolved eagerly in the constructor from import.meta.url, which a bundled Worker does not have
bug_found_by_running_it.fix: resolve lazily inside icons(); a failure is already recorded as icon-missing and fails only that email
